Product:{\"sku\":\"7100132493\"}.description({\"html\":true}):
The Peabody Award-winning 1000xRESIST is a thrilling sci-fi adventure. 1000 years in the future, humanity is all but extinguished, and a disease spread by an alien occupation keeps the survivors underground. You are Watcher. You dutifully fulfil your purpose in service of the ALLMOTHER, until the day you learn a shocking secret that changes everything.

THE END OF HUMANITY
In the near future, we learn we are not alone in the universe. A mysterious alien race of giant entities arrives. We call them the Occupants.

They are not hostile, but it doesn’t matter. Their arrival is a death sentence. Humanity is wiped out in a matter of months, succumbing to a disease the Occupants have brought to our planet.

There is one survivor, a teenage girl called Iris. Somehow she is immune.

SOCIETY IS REBORN IN HER IMAGE
1000 years later. Iris is not only immune, but immortal. She has birthed a new society consisting exclusively of her own clones. She calls them Sisters. They call her the ALLMOTHER.

RELIVE HER MEMORIES
Within the Orchard, every sister has an assigned function, while six sisters have special roles to play. As the new Watcher, Your role is unique. You have the great privilege of reliving and interpreting the memories of the ALLMOTHER through a process known as Communion, made possible by Secretary, your floating AI companion. You're excited to embark on your first Communion.

RESIST A THOUSAND-YEAR-OLD LIE
Your closest sister, Fixer, comes to you with a dangerous revelation. You have been lied to. The ALLMOTHER is not what she claims to be. Fixer’s claims rock the foundations of your world, throwing everything you know and believe into doubt as it falls to you to discover the truth.

DISCOVER THE TRUTH
Dive into the memories of the ALLMOTHER and explore pivotal moments in her life, jumping back and forth through moments in time to solve puzzles and access locked-off areas and secrets.

A STORY LIKE NO OTHER
Experience perspective shifts both literal and metaphorical as the game blends between 3rd person adventure, visual novel and first person walking simulator while throwing twists, turns and revelations at you until you question everything you think you know.
